NEWS_SAMPLE_BODY:
[b]Welcome to VYgo[/b]

This in-game announcement uses the scrolling content layout of the original patch notes and the main menu back navigation.

[b]Main Menu News[/b]

Each time you launch the game, the main menu tries to fetch news in your current language. Local content remains available if the connection fails, so you can start playing right away.

[b]Read and Explore[/b]

Click a news item to open an in-game page or a related link in the Steam browser. Use the back button to return to the main menu.

[b]Language Support[/b]

News and this page support Chinese, English, and Japanese. Changing the game language updates the main menu content.

Thank you for playing and sharing your feedback!
